claims.text: The order count is published annually and is rising. The Federation of American Scientists' table, sourced to the Patent and Trademark Office, records secrecy orders in effect at fiscal year end of 5,976 (FY21), 6,057 (FY22), 6,155 (FY23), 6,471 (FY24) and 6,543 (FY25), with 356 new orders imposed in FY24 against 102 in FY25.
